crossRefs.note: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.
crossRefs.keyword: prospered, etc. Heb. going, went and was hard against

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jabin
people.line: Canaanite king who oppressed Israel; defeated by Deborah and Barak.

translations.web: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
translations.bsb: And the hand of the Israelites grew stronger and stronger against Jabin king of Canaan until they destroyed him.
translations.kjv: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
translations.asv: And the hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
